name: Tuner
author: jacob-sabella
summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.
